Partly built

Open-source maintainers

A review room will recommend reviewers from their skills and history, and continuous integration will be the checker.

Partly built. Some of the steps below exist today and the rest are still to come. The lists at the bottom show which.

How it runs

  1. EventA pull request via GitHubOpens a review room.
  2. ProposalThe assistant via modelProposes two reviewers from their declared skills and the repository's history.
  3. PlanThe reviewers via person outsideReview the change.
  4. ReceiptContinuous integration via connected dataA green run verifies the work; receipts credit the contributors.
